b6127b6f2e90d6f9.description: Job Location- Remote, India Full Time The company is building AI engineering and infrastructure services focused on AI security, token efficiency and deployment readiness. We are hiring an early engineering team to build a reusable secure AI factory foundation and extend it through customer projects. **Your role** Own detailed software design and hands-on implementation under an architect’s direction. Build reusable automation and integrations, review code and guide two junior or mid-level engineers. The secure AI factory scope is the software layer connecting models, deployment workflows, security controls and basic observability. **What you will do** Build Python services and APIs for model access, provider configuration and integration with approved cloud and frontier LLM endpoints. Implement policy-based LLM routing, timeouts, retries and fallbacks, respecting model eligibility, data-handling constraints, quality, latency and cost. Automate installation, configuration, upgrades and smoke testing of selected agentic platforms using Docker and scripted deployment workflows. Implement secrets handling, access controls and audit events. Apply safe logging practices that avoid exposing credentials or sensitive prompts and responses. Instrument request latency, errors, token usage and estimated model cost. Build basic dashboards and alerts; document pricing assumptions and reconcile estimates where usage data permits. Create reusable connectors, deployment templates, automated tests and runbooks. Review code, troubleshoot integrations and separate shared components from customer configuration. **What you bring** Strong Python backend development, REST APIs, authentication, asynchronous workflows and production troubleshooting. Hands-on Docker, Linux, Git, automated testing and CI/CD; practical integration experience with at least one cloud environment. Ability to translate architecture guidance into maintainable components, explain tradeoffs and mentor other developers. Candidates must be familiar with AI-assisted development (“vibe coding”) tools to accelerate development, troubleshooting and bug fixes, while reviewing and testing generated code for quality and security. Clear written communication, ownership and effective collaboration in a remote team. Useful additional experience LLM APIs or gateways, agent frameworks, observability instrumentation, infrastructure automation and production AI integrations. Experience with one relevant AI deployment is particularly valuable; expertise in every platform is not required. **Scope and collaboration** Work with the architect and infrastructure and security specialists. Infrastructure teams own underlying GPU and cluster provisioning; this role owns software integration and automation. Success balances security, token cost, quality and deployment time.

About the role
Percona is hiring a GTM Coordinator to support go-to-market execution for our Cloud Native product line: PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB Kubernetes Operators. You will work alongside the Product Marketing Manager / GTM Owner to keep launches, campaigns, content, and community programs running on time and organized, giving you hands-on exposure to product marketing for a Kubernetes-native, open source product line.
What you'll do

• 
Coordinate launch logistics for new releases, features, and service offerings: timelines, checklists, cross-team follow-ups, and asset tracking.

• 
Help build and maintain GTM assets, including web page updates, datasheets, case studies, and sales enablement materials, working from briefs provided by the PMM/GTM Owner.

• 
Support event and CFP logistics for Kubernetes and database community events (submission tracking, deadlines, speaker coordination)

What you'll bring

• 
An interest in tech marketing.

• 
1+ years of experience in a marketing, GTM, or coordination role.

• 
Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple deadlines and stakeholders at once.

• 
Good writing skills and attention to detail.

• 
Basic comfort with data: pulling numbers together, spotting patterns, building simple reports.

• 
Fluency in English (written and spoken).

• 
A proactive mindset: comfortable asking questions, following up, and keeping things moving without needing every step spelt out.

Why Percona?
At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.
Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.
Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.
If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!
Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

About AIM Intelligent Machines
AIM Intelligent Machines is pioneering the future of heavy equipment automation. Our technology enables a single operator to monitor and control multiple machines simultaneously—dramatically improving productivity, reducing labor costs, and reshaping what's possible in construction, mining, and industrial operations.
Through cutting-edge AI, computer vision, and robotics, AIM is solving critical challenges in equipment autonomy and remote operations. We're building systems that augment human capability—allowing people to do more with less, safely and efficiently.
We are growing quickly and looking for experienced, motivated Account Managers to accelerate adoption of our solutions by building strong partnerships and cultivating strategic customer relationships.
 
Position Summary
As Dealer Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in scaling AIM’s groundbreaking heavy equipment automation platform. You’ll be responsible for growing revenue through both channel partners and direct key accounts, with a clear focus on companies looking to deploy machine automation that allows one operator to manage fleets of equipment.
You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams—including sales leadership, product, and engineering—to help customers modernize their operations and gain a competitive edge through AIM’s autonomous systems.

Channel Partner Management

Build and grow relationships with channel partners (resellers, OEMs, system integrators) to drive adoption of AIM’s automation platform.

Enable and train partners to sell AIM solutions focused on multi-machine control and operator augmentation.

Monitor partner performance and support business planning to meet joint sales targets.
• 
Identify new partners in strategic markets (construction, mining, landfill and quarry environments.
 
Key Account Management
• 
Identify and engage high-potential enterprise accounts seeking to modernize heavy equipment operations through automation, specifically in the mining, landfill and quarry markets.
• 
Understand customer workflows and pain points, and position AIM’s multi-machine control solutions as a strategic advantage.
• 
Lead the sales process from discovery through close, with support from technical teams.
• 
Maintain strong post-sale relationships to drive expansion and long-term success.
 
Internal Collaboration

Work with marketing to create partner- and industry-specific messaging and campaigns.
• 
Partner with product teams to communicate market feedback and help shape feature development

Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, and performance metrics.
 
Qualifications & Skills

3–7 years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or channel sales—preferably in earthworks tech, industrial ground engagement automation, and heavy machinery.

Experience selling or supporting technology that transforms field operations or operator workflows.

Strong understanding of the construction or mining ecosystem—including OEMs, contractors, equipment dealers, and tech providers.
• 
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
• 
Self-starter with the ability to operate in a fast-moving, highly innovative environment.

b62e58bbbe36e4a3.description:
About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale ElevenLabs' Public Sector Partner Programme in North America — bringing together resellers, VARs, and systems integrators who help deploy our technology across federal agencies, state and local governments, and education institutions.
You'll own the public sector partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs and VARs with established public sector practices, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products into government and education accounts.
This is a 0→1 build: you'll design partner incentive and enablement models tailored to the procurement and compliance realities of the public sector, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against North America growth targets — while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance.
 
What success looks like (first 6–9 months)
• 
Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through VARs, SIs, and channel partners reaching at least 20% of North America public sector revenue
• 
Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise and agency-level opportunities in federal, SLED, and education
• 
Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter
• 
Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal
• 
Strategic Account Penetration: new agency and institution relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly
Requirements
• 
10+ years building and scaling SaaS or Cloud solutions into public sector markets, with a deep network across federal, SLED, and education that you can leverage from day one
• 
4+ years owning VAR and SI partnerships in the public sector, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell motions, and revenue — not just relationship management
• 
Deep familiarity with government procurement cycles, contract vehicles (e.g. GSA schedules, BPAs), and compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, StateRAMP)
• 
A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme
• 
Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and agency stakeholders
Bonus: Mix of 3–4 years in direct public sector sales + 3–4 years in partnerships or channel; prior experience at a company scaling into gov-tech from a commercial base

b6959572992b6409.description:
About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.
Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.
The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.
Your responsibilities will include:
• 
Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.
• 
Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.
• 
Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.
• 
Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.
You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements
We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.
We are looking for:
• 
Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.
• 
Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.
• 
Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.
• 
Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.
We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.
Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.
Location:
This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.
 
#LI-Remote
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
